name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
summary: Credit-linked subsidy support for eligible new micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector.
eligibility_summary: Applicant and project conditions apply; age, education, category and rural/urban location affect matching.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
summary: Institutional collateral-free credit for eligible micro enterprises through lending institutions.
eligibility_summary: Eligible individuals/businesses and lender appraisal apply. Categories include Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus.
source_reference: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
summary: Credit-linked capital subsidy and ecosystem support for eligible micro food-processing enterprises, including ODOP-linked support.
eligibility_summary: Food-processing activity, applicant/entity and state/ODOP conditions must be checked against current guidelines.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund
summary: Infrastructure financing support for dairy processing/value addition, animal feed and other eligible animal-husbandry infrastructure.
eligibility_summary: Individual entrepreneurs, private companies, MSMEs, FPOs, Section 8 companies and dairy cooperatives may qualify subject to current operational guidelines.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises
summary: Credit guarantee support to eligible lenders for credit facilities to eligible MSEs.
eligibility_summary: MSE and lender eligibility apply; the guarantee is provided to the lender rather than directly paid to the borrower.

name: Stand-Up India
summary: Bank finance for eligible greenfield enterprises promoted by women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
eligibility_summary: Applicant category, greenfield status, ownership/control and bank appraisal conditions apply.

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: Credit and non-credit support package for eligible artisans/craftspeople in notified traditional trades.
eligibility_summary: Trade must be in the notified list and beneficiary conditions must be satisfied.

name: National Livestock Mission
summary: Entrepreneurship and breed-development support for livestock, poultry and feed/fodder activities.
eligibility_summary: Activity-specific eligibility and beneficiary/entity rules apply.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
summary: Financing support for eligible post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
eligibility_summary: Eligible beneficiary, asset and project conditions must be checked under the current operational guidelines.

name: PM-KUSUM
summary: Support for solar pumps, solarisation of agricultural pumps and eligible solar power projects.
eligibility_summary: Farmer/project/location and state implementation conditions apply.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
summary: Support for fisheries, aquaculture infrastructure and value-chain activities.
eligibility_summary: Activity and beneficiary eligibility under current fisheries guidelines apply.

name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres
summary: Support for eligible trained agriculture professionals establishing agri-clinics/agri-business centres.
eligibility_summary: Education/training and activity-specific eligibility rules apply.

name: DAY-NULM Self Employment Programme
summary: Self-employment support for eligible urban poor through individual/group enterprises.
eligibility_summary: Urban-poor and current SEP eligibility conditions apply.

name: DAY-NRLM
summary: Rural livelihood and enterprise support through SHGs, federations and financial inclusion mechanisms.
eligibility_summary: Primarily relevant to eligible rural SHG/livelihood ecosystems; state implementation varies.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
summary: Working-capital credit support for eligible street vendors.
eligibility_summary: Street-vendor status and scheme-specific eligibility are required.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
summary: Financial assistance for proof of concept, prototype, trials, market entry and commercialization through eligible incubators.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognition, incorporation age and other scheme criteria apply.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups
summary: Credit guarantee support for debt extended by eligible member institutions to DPIIT-recognised startups.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT-recognised startup, lender/member-institution and current framework conditions apply.

name: A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship
summary: Support for innovation, rural industry and entrepreneurship through approved mechanisms such as livelihood business incubators.
eligibility_summary: Beneficiary/institution and component-specific project conditions apply.

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
summary: Cluster-based support for traditional industries and artisan ecosystems.
eligibility_summary: Cluster/institution/entity and component-specific conditions apply.

name: National SC-ST Hub
summary: Support ecosystem for SC/ST entrepreneurs and MSEs, including procurement and capacity-building support.
eligibility_summary: SC/ST-owned MSE and component-specific rules apply.

name: Punjab Startup Incentives / Industrial & Business Development Policy
summary: Punjab policy framework contains startup incentives; the exact current policy/version must be checked before matching.
eligibility_summary: Punjab location plus startup registration/recognition and current policy conditions.

name: Punjab Term Loan to SC
summary: Punjab government service listing for term-loan assistance to eligible SC beneficiaries.
eligibility_summary: SC category plus Punjab implementing-agency income/asset/loan conditions must be verified.

name: Punjab Term Loan to OBC
summary: Punjab government service listing for term-loan assistance to eligible OBC beneficiaries.
eligibility_summary: OBC category plus Punjab implementing-agency income/asset/loan conditions must be verified.

name: SBI PMMY
summary: SBI lending channel for PMMY; lender-specific appraisal and pricing apply.
eligibility_summary: PMMY eligibility plus SBI credit appraisal and current bank terms.

name: SBI Food Processing Industry Loan
summary: Industry-specific SBI lending product for food-processing businesses.
eligibility_summary: Bank credit appraisal, security, project and financial conditions apply.

name: SBI Construction Equipment Loan
summary: Industry-specific equipment finance product listed by SBI.
eligibility_summary: Asset, borrower and bank credit appraisal conditions apply.

name: PNB Digi MSME Loan
summary: PNB digital MSME lending product listed in its MSME scheme catalogue.
eligibility_summary: Current PNB product eligibility and credit appraisal apply.

name: PNB e-Mudra
summary: PNB channel/product for MUDRA lending.
eligibility_summary: Current PMMY and PNB product rules apply.
